sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3 reference table for lukp1238 (23 references; Hammarström et al.).
sources.note: Bibliographic only. No entry typed 'phonology'; descriptive items are Pickering 1974 (grammar sketch), Akawe Akayokoti 2001 (grammar sketch), Cornevin 1959, Karan 1983 (discourse), Mauani 1992; plus wordlists (Koelle 1854, Christaller 1889, CNLT 1983) and comparative works (Delord 1988, Beyer 1998).

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en) 'Lukpa language'; Wikipedia (fr) 'Lokpa (langue)' citing CENALA 2008, Alphabet des langues nationales béninoises (6th ed.) and the 2003 Lokpa Bible.
sources.note: fr.wikipedia: the standard orthography marks high tone with an acute accent on vowels and nasals (secondary report of the CENALA alphabet); nothing on stress. Not a descriptive source.

sources.citation: Hartell, Rhonda L. (ed.). 1993. Alphabets of Africa. Dakar: UNESCO & SIL. p. 33 'Lokpa (Dompago) (Gur)' (Benin).
sources.note: One-page phoneme/grapheme chart (26 graphemes, vowel length written VV); no tone marks, no mention of tone, accent or stress.

sources.citation: Glottolog languoid page lukp1238 and md.ini (names, classification refs Manessy 1969, Kleinewillinghöfer 1997; links to PHOIBLE/Wikipedia/Wikidata).
sources.note: Nothing on prosody. PHOIBLE page for lukp1238 exists but shows no inventory/source (read online, no file).
